title: Requirements plan
description: The operator's choices that size the lab, as bootstrap and the installer write them and pinka-preflight --plan reads them. A missing key takes the configured default (preflight/requirements.json defaults).

inference.description: The inference switch (inference): auto serves where gpu_inference is detected on a full or inference node and the serving profile and the default model fit the GPU; on must serve there (a host that cannot is unsupported, as is an inference node that cannot under either); off installs and counts no vLLM, inference image or model. A lab node refuses on.

docker_data_root.description: Docker's data root, where the container images go.

pool.description: The Incus storage pool: a loop file of size_gib counts fully on its mount point; a dedicated device on none. size_gib null: auto, the sum of everything that may be written to the pool (preflight/requirements.yml pool). volume_size_gib: the pool's volume.size (incus_pool_volume_size); null: auto, just above the largest unpacked image.

device.description: The dedicated pool device (incus_pool_device, source device); empty for a loop file.

researchers.description: Researchers, each with a personal Incus project (the length of researchers).

personal_disk_gib.description: A personal project's limits.disk in GiB (incus_user_limits merged with its defaults); it counts in full, once per researcher, in the Incus pool's size.

incus_disk.description: The sizes the Incus pool's sum reads, from the incus role's profiles and project limits merged key by key with their defaults, as the role renders them. bench_limits_disk_gib and build_limits_disk_gib: an explicit limits.disk of incus_bench_limits or incus_build_limits; null: computed from the profiles.

model.description: The model vLLM serves after the install (vllm_default_deployment.model_id) as models.lock.yml pins it, with the sum of its files' sizes; null: none.

vllm_profile.description: The serving profile (vllm_profile, vllm/profiles/<name>.yml) whose GPU minimum and model estimates apply.

images.description: The golden image blueprints to build (images_blueprints).

training.description: The training switch (training) and caps (training_caps.memory_max and run_storage_max).

mode.description: auto trains where gpu_training is detected on a full node; cpu also runs the CPU-only variant without a usable GPU; off runs no job.

memory_max_gib.description: training_caps.memory_max; null: auto, computed from the host.

retention.description: The retention settings, in days (pg_dumps: the dumps kept, one a day); prometheus_size_gib 0 means by time only.
